messages:
Marcel (partnerships): Heads-up  marketplace team asked for a single playbook: what we accept as evidence (SOC, pentest, questionnaires), what metadata we store, and how long we keep it. Anyone free to sync?
Zoe (security): I'm free. Quick summary: need to record vendor, date, scope, signed attestation, and whether the artifact contains customer data. Also require KMS encryption and an access audit trail.
Lin (eng-ops): Tech note: we can store artifacts in s3://redwood-marketplace-artifacts, tag objects, and maintain a Dynamo ledger with searchable fields. Lifecycle rules can act on tags like `retain=24m`.
Jenna (legal): Contract note: our default retention for external-facing artifacts is 12 months unless the marketplace or contract requires longer. We should add an opt-in clause for extended retention and an NDA path for full disclosures.
Kai (partner-ops): Marketplaces differ. AWS often wants 24 months, GCP sometimes asks for the last 2 years of tests, Azure wants an attestation for data flows. Can we publish a mapping table?
Marcel (partnerships): Yes — publishing a mapping table would reduce back-and-forth. Can we also add a short description to the upload modal so partners know what to include?
Lin (eng-ops): Upload API will accept multipart JSON fields: `type`, `retain_months`, `sensitivity`, `marketplace`, `vendor`, `test_date`, `scope_summary`, `signed_by`, `contains_customer_data` (bool). We'll persist a SHA256 and HMAC in the ledger.
Zoe (security): For sensitivity: `normal` = auto-delete allowed, `high` = manual retention review + no auto-delete. For SOC2 Type II baseline I propose 15 months (covers rolling testing windows). Pentest baseline 24 months. Questionnaires 12 months.
Jenna (legal): I'm OK with those baselines as defaults if contracts can override. Make sure to document redaction rules: we provide redacted artifacts by default, full artifacts only with NDA and a documented transfer.
artifact-bot: Note: lifecycle rule `marketplace-by-tag` applied to bucket by lin at 2026-04-08T05:12Z.
Kai (partner-ops): Partners want notifications before purge. Suggested cadence: 60 / 30 / 7 days. Also allow a one-time archival purchase to move to cold storage for 5+ years.
Lin (eng-ops): We'll wire SNS -> Lambda -> email. Also surface pending expirations in the partner portal and allow listing owners to extend or opt into archive.
Zoe (security): Add an audit event on downloads: who, when, SHA256, purpose. Also require partnership-review role for marketplace reviewers.
Marcel (partnerships): Can the upload UI validate presence of required fields and warn if `contains_customer_data=true`?
Lin (eng-ops): Yes — UI validation + a server-side check. If `contains_customer_data=true` we add `sensitivity:high` automatically and flag legal + security.
Jenna (legal): Also require `scope_summary` and `signed_by` for pen-tests. Add chain-of-custody metadata in the ledger (uploader id, upload timestamp, original filename).
Kai (partner-ops): We should include a small example snippet in docs for partners. e.g., `curl -X POST /uploads -F file=@pentest.pdf -F type=pentest -F retain_months=24 -F vendor=AcmeSec -F test_date=2026-02-20`.
Zoe (security): For export to auditors: we send redacted versions automatically. Full artifacts only via one-time pre-signed URL with token + NDA record. Log every disclosure event.
Marcel (partnerships): Action items: Jenna draft contract clause + redaction process; Zoe finalize sensitivity matrix & audit fields; Lin implement uploader fields + lifecycle + notification; Kai build marketplace mapping sheet; I'll update partner onboarding.
Jenna (legal): I'll put a draft in the partnerships folder and ping for review by Thursday EOD.
Lin (eng-ops): I'll open an RFC and prototype the uploader this sprint; ETA: two weeks for initial rollout.
Zoe (security): I'll circulate the matrix and required IAM policy for `partnership-review` role.
artifact-bot: Scheduled job `artifact-expiry-check` runs daily at 03:00 UTC.
Marcel (partnerships): Great, thanks all. If anyone hears specific marketplace reviewers asking for extra docs, ping the thread and we'll add mapping entries.
